version.changelog:
- Added installation instructions in both Chinese (for humans) and English (for agents) to SKILL.md.
- Clarified required environment variables (VIKUNJA_URL, VIKUNJA_TOKEN) and their setup process.
- Bumped skill version to 2.2.0.
- No API or functional changes—documentation only.

llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it says — a simple Vikunja v2 API client using curl/jq and an API token (or username/password fallback) — with a few metadata inconsistencies to verify before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the requested capabilities: the skill needs network access to a Vikunja instance and curl/jq to call the API. The included shell helper implements the documented endpoints; no unrelated services or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions ask the agent to read and write a secure env file (/root/.openclaw/workspace/secure/api-fillin.env) to store VIKUNJA_URL and VIKUNJA_TOKEN and to use those values when calling $VIKUNJA_URL/api/v1/*. Reading a secure credential file is expected for this integration, but you should confirm that storing tokens in that specific path matches your security practice. The script also supports username/password fallback and will POST credentials to $VIKUNJA_URL/login to obtain a token (expected behavior for Vikunja).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with a small included shell script; there is no package download or extract step and no ability to write arbitrary binaries to disk beyond the provided file.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Required envs are proportional: VIKUNJA_URL and VIKUNJA_TOKEN (primary) are appropriate. The script optionally accepts VIKUNJA_USERNAME and VIKUNJA_PASSWORD as a fallback; that is justified by the login flow but you should be aware the skill may transmit those credentials to your Vikunja instance to obtain a token.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated or cross-skill configuration changes. It does request access to a secure workspace env file, which is normal for secret storage but worth confirming against your environment's secret handling policy.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a straightforward Vikunja API client. Before installing: (1) confirm the skill's source/trustworthiness since registry metadata (ownerId and version) in the package files differ from the registry entry; (2) ensure you are comfortable storing your VIKUNJA_TOKEN (or username/password) at the referenced secure env path and that the path is actually secure in your deployment; (3) prefer using an API token (VIKUNJA_TOKEN) over username/password; (4) note the script will POST credentials to your Vikunja server to obtain a token if only username/password are provided; and (5) verify curl and jq are available. If you need higher assurance, request the publisher sign or reconcile the metadata/version mismatches and inspect the full SKILL.md file yourself.
